name: Reversible deployment
description: Prepare and verify a deployment artifact in a safe preview path while preserving health evidence and a known rollback route.

outcomes.description: A reviewed artifact is reproducible, identifiable, and suitable for the declared target.
The previous release and health signal remain identifiable for a bounded rollback.

prerequisites.description: The source change has passed its relevant checks and has a named integration reference.
prerequisites.check: Inspect the diff summary, test result, and canonical reference before packaging.

prerequisites.description: The target, owner boundary, health signal, and previous release identifier are known.
prerequisites.check: Write the target facts without copying credentials or private configuration values.

lanes.objective: Define artifact, target, health, owner boundary, and rollback evidence.
Build and inspect the deployment artifact without changing the reviewed source scope.
Verify the preview or staging health signal and the previous-release rollback route.

qualityGates.description: The artifact builds from the reviewed source and has a safe identifying summary.
The preview or staging health signal and key user path behave as expected.
The prior release remains identifiable and its restoration route is documented.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response for deployment access.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; prepare the artifact and preview evidence without typing secrets.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Promote live traffic, change account security or billing, perform destructive work, or execute live financial behavior.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: This recipe proves a reversible preview; live impact needs a separate decision.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the previous release identifiable and restore it through the approved reversible route if health evidence fails.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted artifact and health summaries.
Do not remove the previous release while the new health signal is uncertain.
Record the deployment as abandoned when no safe proof exists.
stopConditions: The artifact cannot be tied to reviewed source.
The health signal is unavailable or contradictory.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and private configuration values.
Record release identifiers and safe status summaries only.
